text:
frank: opened a small PR to update the AsterA9B model card and the catalog variant table. fixes: broken perf link, clarify context vs tokens, add migration checklist for deprecated 'astera9b-legacy'. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5099 :wave:

yana: skimmedlooks good. note: bench CSV path 404s for astera9b; perf job must have renamed the artifact.

kevin: also the SDK example still uses CatalogClient.list_models(). we should change to catalog.list_variants() and show limits keys explicitly. tiny snippet suggestion: 
```python
from redwood import CatalogClient
cat = CatalogClient()
for v in cat.list_variants("astera9b"):
    print(v["name"], v["limits"])
```

perf-bot: artifact check: /bench/astera9b/2026-03-20/astera9b_throughput.csv -> NOT FOUND. Please reupload with current perf pipeline name.

frank: asked perf offline; perf re-uploaded to /bench/astera9b/2026-03-25/astera9b_throughput_v2.csv. updated PR link.

yana: migration checklist idea: 1) pin new variant in runtime config, 2) run deterministic token-diff: `redwood eval --model astera9b-legacy --model astera9b-v2 --prompt-file tiny_set.txt --temperature 0.0 --output diffs.json`, 3) canary 5% for 24h. include that as bullets.

kevin: add a quick shell example to run the deterministic diff locally and a short SDK snippet to programmatically check `max_sequence` before routing.

frank: added both snippets. also a compatibility note: "quantized variants may expose reduced max_sequence; verify variant limits before pinning."

ops-bot: lint: table cell at /catalog/variants.md line 210 >120 chars. suggest moving bench rig details to footnote.

frank: moved rig details (a100-40gb, seq=1024, dyn-batching=off) to footnote and shortened inline text. pushed.

yana: left one tiny wording nit about "pinning" -> "pin to variant id". fixed.

kevin: approving once CI links scan confirms the new artifact resolves.

perf-bot: artifact check: /bench/astera9b/2026-03-25/astera9b_throughput_v2.csv -> OK.

kevin: approved. landing after green CI. will open follow-up PR to update a couple of old CLI hrefs in sdk docs.

frank: thanks all 6a4 will merge after CI passes and then follow up with the CLI link patch.
